A Note From the Founder

Welcome to Pixie's Pantry

Hey everyone, Dusty here. I want to be completely transparent with you: I built this storefront entirely from the ground up. If you spot a misaligned image or a work-in-progress layout, that's on me. It isn’t pixel-perfect yet, but I’m constantly auditing and refining the site.

What matters most is that every single purchase you make directly supports this ecosystem. It keeps the lights on and helps me build a solid future for my six-year-old daughter. I appreciate your business more than an automated thank-you email can convey.

I’ve spent countless hours vetting suppliers, comparing technical specs, and negotiating margins to bring you the best possible value on these devices. I don't believe in marking hardware up just because the market allows it.

Looking ahead, my primary operational goal is getting our inventory fully FSA/HSA eligible. I believe this hardware shouldn't just be viewed as retail items, but as accessible wellness tools. We aren’t across that finish line yet, but the paperwork is actively in the pipeline.

In the meantime, if you want to bypass standard retail pricing, you need to be in our Discord. That’s my direct channel for dropping exclusive wholesale discounts, bulk savings, and community-only pricing.
